title: The prairie holds on
text: Rain has softened the trail. A wheel cracks in a deep rut. Fit a spare wheel, or spend tomorrow digging free and patching the old one.

choices.label: Replace the wheel · 1 spare wheel
choices.result: The replacement wheel holds. The wagon is ready.

choices.label: Dig it free · 1 day, with food consumed
choices.result: Mud, shovels, and a long day. At last the wagon is free.

title: Kansas River crossing
text: You have reached the Kansas River. The current is strong. A ferryman offers passage for $15. Floating the wagon costs nothing, but risks food and health. Crossing completes this first leg.

choices.label: Hire the ferry · $15 and 1 day
choices.result: The ferry carries your party safely across. First leg complete.

choices.label: Caulk and float · 1 day, 35% mishap risk

risk.text: Water pours over the side. Supplies are lost, but everyone reaches shore.

choices.result: The wagon reaches the far bank. First leg complete.

title: An elegant fence post
text: A metal cylinder lies in the grass. A blue blade hums into existence. Your family agrees this is probably a new kind of plow.

choices.label: Keep the lightsaber
choices.result: Lightsaber packed. Its agricultural applications remain unproven.

title: The 2002 Toyota Corolla
text: A beige Corolla idles beside the trail. The odometer reads 287,000. A note says: 'Still runs.' There is enough fuel for about 90 miles. Keep the wagon hitched behind it for when the tank runs dry.

choices.label: Drive it · 30 miles/day while fuel lasts
choices.result: The oxen ride in the back. No one discusses the logistics.

choices.label: Stay with the wagon
choices.result: You leave the keys on the seat.

title: The thing beyond the ford
text: The horizon unfolds into an elder god. It asks for a modest offering of trail biscuits. This was absent from the guidebook.

choices.label: Offer 20 lb of food · recover 10 health
choices.result: The sky knits itself together. Everyone feels strangely rested.

choices.label: Politely decline · lose 5 health
choices.result: It accepts your refusal. Your dreams will be less accommodating.
